source.text: אָ֚ז יִקְרָ֣א יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ לָרֽאוּבֵנִ֖י וְלַגָּדִ֑י וְלַחֲצִ֖י מַטֵּ֥ה מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: Then summoned Joshua the Reubenites and the Gadites and half [the] tribe of Manasseh.

en.L: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
en.B: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
en.R: Then Joshua called together the tribes of Reuben and Gad and half of the tribe of Manasseh.

sw.L: Ndipo Yoshua akawaita Wareubeni na Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase.
sw.B: Ndipo Yoshua akawaita Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase.
sw.R: Kisha Yoshua akayakusanya makabila ya Reubeni na Gadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase.

es.L: Entonces Josué convocó a los rubenitas, y a los gaditas, y a la media tribu de Manasés.
es.B: Entonces Josué convocó a los rubenitas, a los gaditas y a la media tribu de Manasés.
es.R: Entonces Josué reunió a las tribus de Rubén y Gad y a la mitad de la tribu de Manasés.

fr.L: Alors Josué convoqua les Rubénites, et les Gadites, et la demi-tribu de Manassé.
fr.B: Alors Josué convoqua les Rubénites, les Gadites et la demi-tribu de Manassé.
fr.R: Alors Josué a réuni les tribus de Ruben et de Gad et la moitié de la tribu de Manassé.

vi.L: Bấy giờ Giô-suê triệu tập người Ru-bên, người Gát và nửa chi phái Ma-na-se.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Giô-suê triệu tập người Ru-bên, người Gát và nửa chi phái Ma-na-se.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Giô-suê gọi các chi phái Ru-bên và Gát cùng nửa chi phái Ma-na-se đến.

ko.L: 그때 여호수아가 르우벤 사람과 갓 사람과 므낫세 반 지파를 불렀다.
ko.B: 그때 여호수아가 르우벤 사람과 갓 사람과 므낫세 반 지파를 불러 모았다.
ko.R: 그때 여호수아가 르우벤 지파와 갓 지파와 므낫세 지파의 절반을 불러 모았다.

decisions.choice: the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh: the tribes that settled east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: These two and a half tribes had received land east of the Jordan from Moses on condition that their fighting men cross over and fight beside the other tribes until the whole land was taken (Numbers 32; Deuteronomy 3:12-20). Joshua held them to it before the crossing (1:12-18), and now that the land has been divided he releases them.

decisions.choice: then: at that time, when the land had been given and had rest
decisions.reason: "Then" ties the scene to the close of the land division (21:43-45), when the LORD had given Israel rest from its enemies. It marks the time in general terms; it does not say the scene followed the last chapter immediately.

decisions.choice: the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh (Balanced); the tribes of Reuben and Gad and half of the tribe of Manasseh (Readable)
decisions.reason: The three eastern groups are named many times in this chapter, in slightly different Hebrew forms ("the Reubenite", "the sons of Reuben"). Balanced and Readable name them in the same words every time, as 1:12 does, so the reader can follow them; Literal shows the Hebrew form.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֣ם שְׁמַרְתֶּ֔ם אֵ֚ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה וַתִּשְׁמְע֣וּ בְקוֹלִ֔י לְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶתְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to them, You, you have kept all that commanded you Moses [the] slave of Yahweh, and you have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.

en.L: And he said to them, "You have kept all that Moses the slave of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded you, and you have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.
en.B: He said to them, "You have carried out all that Moses the servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded you, and in everything I have commanded you, you have obeyed me.
en.R: He said to them, "You have done everything Moses, the servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, told you to do. And you have obeyed me in everything I told you to do.

sw.L: Akawaambia, "Ninyi mmeshika yote ambayo Musa mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaamuru, nanyi mmesikiliza sauti yangu katika yote niliyowaamuru.
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Mmetekeleza yote ambayo Musa mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaamuru, na katika kila jambo nililowaamuru mmenitii.
sw.R: Akawaambia, "Mmefanya kila kitu ambacho Musa, mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliwaambia mfanye. Nanyi mmenitii katika kila jambo nililowaambia mfanye.

es.L: Y les dijo: «{{plural_you:Ustedes han|Vosotros habéis}} guardado todo lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} mandó Moisés, el siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y {{plural_you:han|habéis}} escuchado mi voz en todo lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} mandé.
es.B: Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Ustedes han|Vosotros habéis}} cumplido todo lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} mandó Moisés, el siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y en todo lo que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} he mandado me {{plural_you:han|habéis}} obedecido.
es.R: Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Ustedes han|Vosotros habéis}} hecho todo lo que Moisés, el siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} mandó hacer. Y me {{plural_you:han|habéis}} obedecido en todo lo que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} mandé hacer.

fr.L: Et il leur dit : « Vous, vous avez gardé tout ce que vous a ordonné Moïse, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et vous avez écouté ma voix en tout ce que je vous ai ordonné.
fr.B: Il leur dit : « Vous avez accompli tout ce que Moïse, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, vous avait ordonné, et vous m’avez obéi en tout ce que je vous ai ordonné.
fr.R: Il leur a dit : « Vous avez fait tout ce que Moïse, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, vous avait demandé de faire. Et vous m’avez obéi en tout ce que je vous ai demandé.

vi.L: Ông nói với họ: "Anh em đã giữ mọi điều Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã truyền cho anh em, và anh em đã nghe theo tiếng tôi trong mọi điều tôi đã truyền cho anh em.
vi.B: Ông nói với họ: "Anh em đã làm trọn mọi điều Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã truyền cho anh em, và trong mọi điều tôi đã truyền, anh em đều vâng lời tôi.
vi.R: Ông nói với họ: "Anh em đã làm mọi điều Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã bảo anh em làm. Anh em cũng đã vâng lời tôi trong mọi điều tôi bảo anh em làm.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그들에게 말했다. "너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 너희에게 명령한 모든 것을 지켰고, 내가 너희에게 명령한 모든 일에 내 목소리를 들었다.
ko.B: 여호수아가 그들에게 말했다. "너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 너희에게 명령한 것을 모두 지켰고, 내가 너희에게 명령한 모든 일에서도 내 말에 순종하였다.
ko.R: 여호수아가 그들에게 말했다. "너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 너희에게 하라고 한 일을 모두 하였다. 그리고 내가 너희에게 하라고 한 모든 일에서도 내 말을 잘 따랐다.

decisions.choice: all that Moses commanded you: the terms of Numbers 32
decisions.reason: Moses had told these tribes to cross armed ahead of their fellow tribes and not return home until the land was won (Numbers 32:20-22; Deuteronomy 3:18-20). They had promised Joshua to obey him as they had obeyed Moses (1:16-17). Joshua now says that both promises have been kept.

decisions.choice: listened to my voice: obeyed me
decisions.reason: To listen to someone's voice is a common way of saying to obey (Genesis 22:18; Exodus 19:5).

decisions.choice: slave (Literal); servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1:1, Moses' title follows the project's rule for this word: Literal keeps "slave", Balanced and Readable say "servant".

decisions.choice: plural forms for Joshua's words to the eastern tribes: "ustedes han", "les" by default; "vosotros habéis", "os" with the plural-you setting
decisions.reason: Joshua speaks to the two and a half tribes together, and the Hebrew verbs are plural, so every second-person form takes the plural-you setting, as set at 18:3. Moses keeps his title "el siervo del SEÑOR" at every level (13:8).

decisions.choice: "Moïse, le serviteur du SEIGNEUR" at every level in Joshua's speeches (22:2, 4, 5)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for Moses' title and as recorded at 13:8: "serviteur" at Literal too, where the English has "slave".

decisions.choice: Joshua speaks to the eastern tribes as "anh em" and of himself as "tôi"
decisions.reason: As he speaks to all Israel (18:3): a leader to his fellow Israelites, who have fought beside the others for years.

decisions.choice: Joshua speaks to the eastern tribes in the plain style (해라체), as their leader
decisions.reason: Joshua dismisses the tribes as the leader whose commands they have obeyed (verse 2), so he speaks as he does to all Israel (18:3). The delegation and the eastern tribes later in the chapter speak to one another in the formal polite style (verse 16).

source.text: לֹֽא־עֲזַבְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־אֲחֵיכֶ֗ם זֶ֚ה יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֕ם אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֕רֶת מִצְוַ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you have forsaken your brothers these many days until this day, and you have kept the charge of [the] commandment of Yahweh your God.

en.L: You have not forsaken your brothers these many days, to this day, and you have kept the charge of the commandment of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.B: All this long time, up to this very day, you have not abandoned your fellow Israelites. You have faithfully carried out the duty that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God commanded.
en.R: For a long time now, right up to today, you have not left the other tribes on their own. You have done the work {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God gave you to do.

sw.L: Hamkuwaacha ndugu zenu siku hizi nyingi, hadi siku hii ya leo, nanyi mmeshika agizo la amri ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.
sw.B: Muda huu wote mrefu, mpaka leo hii, hamkuwaacha Waisraeli wenzenu. Mmetekeleza kwa uaminifu wajibu ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu aliamuru.
sw.R: Kwa muda mrefu sasa, mpaka leo, hamkuyaacha makabila mengine peke yao. Mmefanya kazi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu aliwapa mfanye.

es.L: No {{plural_you:han|habéis}} abandonado a {{plural_you:sus hermanos|vuestros hermanos}} estos muchos días, hasta el día de hoy, y {{plural_you:han|habéis}} guardado el encargo del mandamiento {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.
es.B: Durante todo este largo tiempo, hasta el día de hoy, no {{plural_you:han|habéis}} abandonado a {{plural_you:sus compatriotas|vuestros compatriotas}}. {{plural_you:Han|Habéis}} cumplido fielmente el deber que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} {{plural_you:les|os}} mandó.
es.R: Desde hace mucho tiempo, hasta hoy mismo, no {{plural_you:han|habéis}} dejado solas a las demás tribus. {{plural_you:Han|Habéis}} hecho el trabajo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} {{plural_you:les|os}} dio.

fr.L: Vous n’avez pas abandonné vos frères pendant ces nombreux jours, jusqu’à ce jour, et vous avez observé ce qui est prescrit par le commandement {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu.
fr.B: Pendant tout ce long temps, jusqu’à aujourd’hui, vous n’avez pas abandonné vos frères israélites. Vous avez fidèlement accompli la tâche que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu vous avait commandée.
fr.R: Depuis longtemps, et jusqu’à aujourd’hui, vous n’avez pas laissé les autres tribus se débrouiller seules. Vous avez fait le travail que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu vous avait donné à faire.

vi.L: Anh em đã không bỏ anh em mình suốt nhiều ngày qua, cho đến ngày nay, và anh em đã giữ trọn trách nhiệm về điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em.
vi.B: Suốt thời gian dài ấy, cho đến chính ngày nay, anh em đã không bỏ rơi các anh em Y-sơ-ra-ên của mình. Anh em đã trung tín làm trọn nhiệm vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, đã truyền.
vi.R: Đã lâu lắm rồi, cho đến hôm nay, anh em không bỏ mặc các chi phái khác. Anh em đã làm công việc {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, giao cho anh em.

ko.L: 너희는 이 여러 날 동안 오늘까지 너희 형제들을 저버리지 않았고, 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령의 책임을 지켰다.
ko.B: 너희는 이 오랜 기간 동안 오늘까지 너희 형제 이스라엘 사람들을 저버리지 않았고, 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 명령하신 임무를 충실히 지켰다.
ko.R: 너희는 오랫동안, 바로 오늘까지 다른 지파들을 내버려 두지 않았다. 너희는 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 맡기신 일을 다 하였다.

decisions.choice: these many days: the long years of the wars of conquest
decisions.reason: The fighting took a long time (11:18). Caleb's words in 14:7 and 14:10 suggest about seven years from the spying of the land to the sharing out of it.

decisions.choice: the charge of the commandment: the duty entrusted to them by God's command
decisions.reason: The word for "charge" means something given into a person's keeping, a duty to be guarded and carried out (Genesis 26:5; Numbers 3:7). The duty here was to fight until the other tribes had their land.

decisions.choice: your fellow Israelites (Balanced); the other tribes (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Your brothers" means the other tribes of Israel, relatives as one people, not brothers in a family. Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: "compatriotas" (B), with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in Deuteronomy 1:16: Balanced says "compatriotas" for the brothers, as the English says "fellow Israelites"; like "hermanos", it already takes in women, so Spanish has no second wording for a gender setting.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה הֵנִ֨יחַ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ לַֽאֲחֵיכֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וְעַתָּ֡ה פְּנוּ֩ וּלְכ֨וּ לָכֶ֜ם לְאָהֳלֵיכֶ֗ם אֶל־אֶ֨רֶץ֙ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֗ם מֹשֶׁה֙ עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֔ה בְּעֵ֖בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And now has given rest Yahweh your God to your brothers, as he spoke to them; and now turn and go for yourselves to your tents, to [the] land of your possession which gave to you Moses [the] slave of Yahweh across the Jordan.

en.L: And now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has given rest to your brothers, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them. So now turn and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the slave of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave you across the Jordan.
en.B: Now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has given your fellow Israelites rest, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised them. So turn now and go home to your tents, to the land that is your own, which Moses the servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave you on the other side of the Jordan.
en.R: Now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has given the other tribes rest from their enemies, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} promised. So now you may go back home to your own land. It is the land on the east side of the Jordan that Moses, the servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, gave you.

sw.L: Na sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu amewapa ndugu zenu raha, kama alivyowaambia. Basi sasa geukeni mwende hemani mwenu, katika nchi ya milki yenu, ambayo Musa mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa ng'ambo ya Yordani.
sw.B: Sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu amewapa Waisraeli wenzenu raha, kama alivyowaahidi. Basi sasa rudini nyumbani hemani mwenu, katika nchi iliyo yenu wenyewe, ambayo Musa mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa ng'ambo ya Yordani.
sw.R: Sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu amewapa makabila mengine raha kutokana na adui zao, kama alivyoahidi. Kwa hiyo sasa mnaweza kurudi nyumbani katika nchi yenu wenyewe. Ni nchi iliyo upande wa mashariki wa Yordani ambayo Musa, mtumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliwapa.

es.L: Y ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} ha dado reposo a {{plural_you:sus hermanos|vuestros hermanos}}, como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo. Así que ahora {{plural_you:vuelvan y vayan|volved e id}} a {{plural_you:sus tiendas|vuestras tiendas}}, a la tierra de {{plural_you:su posesión|vuestra posesión}}, que Moisés, el siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} dio al otro lado del Jordán.
es.B: Ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} ha dado reposo a {{plural_you:sus compatriotas|vuestros compatriotas}}, como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se lo prometió. Así que {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} ahora a {{plural_you:sus tiendas|vuestras tiendas}}, a la tierra que es {{plural_you:suya|vuestra}}, la que Moisés, el siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} dio al otro lado del Jordán.
es.R: Ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} ha dado a las demás tribus descanso de sus enemigos, tal como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo prometió. Así que ya {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} volver a casa, a {{plural_you:su propia tierra|vuestra propia tierra}}. Es la tierra al lado este del Jordán que Moisés, el siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} dio.

fr.L: Et maintenant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu a donné du repos à vos frères, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le leur avait dit ; et maintenant, retournez et allez-vous-en à vos tentes, au pays de votre possession, que vous a donné Moïse, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, au-delà du Jourdain.
fr.B: Maintenant, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu a donné du repos à vos frères israélites, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le leur avait promis. Retournez donc chez vous, à vos tentes, dans le pays qui est à vous, celui que Moïse, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, vous a donné de l’autre côté du Jourdain.
fr.R: Maintenant, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu a donné aux autres tribus du repos face à leurs ennemis, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’avait promis. Vous pouvez donc rentrer chez vous, dans votre pays. C’est le pays à l’est du Jourdain que Moïse, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, vous a donné.

vi.L: Và bây giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, đã cho anh em của anh em được yên nghỉ, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với họ. Vậy bây giờ, hãy quay về trại mình, về đất sở hữu của anh em, mà Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã ban cho anh em ở bên kia sông Giô-đanh.
vi.B: Bây giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, đã cho các anh em Y-sơ-ra-ên của anh em được yên nghỉ, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với họ. Vậy bây giờ anh em hãy quay về trại mình, về đất của riêng anh em, mà Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã ban cho anh em ở bên kia sông Giô-đanh.
vi.R: Bây giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, đã cho các chi phái khác được yên nghỉ khỏi kẻ thù, đúng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa. Vậy bây giờ anh em có thể trở về nhà, về đất của mình. Đó là đất ở phía đông sông Giô-đanh mà Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã ban cho anh em.

ko.L: 그리고 이제 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 말씀하신 대로 너희 형제들에게 안식을 주셨다. 그러니 이제 너희는 돌아서서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 요단 건너편에서 너희에게 준 너희 소유의 땅, 너희 장막으로 가거라.
ko.B: 이제 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 약속하신 대로 너희 형제들에게 안식을 주셨다. 그러니 이제 돌아서서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 요단강 건너편에서 너희에게 준 너희 땅, 너희 장막으로 돌아가거라.
ko.R: 이제 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 약속하신 대로 다른 지파들에게 원수들에게서 벗어난 안식을 주셨다. 그러니 이제 너희는 너희 땅으로 돌아가도 된다. 그 땅은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 요단강 동쪽에서 너희에게 준 땅이다.

decisions.choice: given rest: a settled life in the land, free from enemies
decisions.reason: Rest was the goal Moses set for the eastern tribes' service: they could go home when the LORD had given their brothers rest as he had given it to them (1:13-15; Deuteronomy 3:20). The narrator has just said that this has happened (21:44).

decisions.choice: go to your tents: go home
decisions.reason: "To your tents" is a set way of saying "home", used long after Israel lived in houses (Judges 7:8; 1 Kings 8:66).

decisions.choice: across the Jordan: here, east of it
decisions.reason: Joshua speaks at Shiloh, west of the river (verse 9), so the land "across the Jordan" is the land on its east side, given by Moses (Numbers 32:33).

decisions.choice: rest from their enemies; on the east side
decisions.reason: Readable says what the rest is and which side of the river is meant, both plain from the context (21:44; verse 9).

records.literal_gloss: Only take care very [much] to do the commandment and the law which commanded you Moses [the] slave of Yahweh, to love Yahweh your God and to walk in all his ways and to keep his commandments and to cling to him and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.

en.L: Only be very careful to do the commandment and the law that Moses the slave of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded you: to love {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and to walk in all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways, and to keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments, and to cling to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and to serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with all your heart and with all your soul."
en.B: But take great care to carry out the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} laid on you: love {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, walk in all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways, keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments, hold fast to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with all your heart and all your soul."
en.R: But be very careful to obey the commands and laws that Moses, the servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, gave you. Love {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. Live the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants you to live, and obey {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commands. Stay close to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with all your heart and with your whole self."

es.B: Pero {{plural_you:pongan|poned}} mucho cuidado en cumplir el mandamiento y la ley que Moisés, el siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} encargó: {{plural_you:amen|amad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, {{plural_you:anden|andad}} en todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos, {{plural_you:guarden|guardad}} {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos, {{plural_you:manténganse|manteneos}} unidos a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y {{plural_you:sírvanle|servidle}} con todo {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}} y con toda {{plural_you:su alma|vuestra alma}}».
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} mucho cuidado de obedecer los mandamientos y las leyes que Moisés, el siervo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} dio. {{plural_you:Amen|Amad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}. {{plural_you:Vivan|Vivid}} como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiere que {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}}, y {{plural_you:obedezcan|obedeced}} {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos. {{plural_you:Manténganse|Manteneos}} cerca de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y {{plural_you:sírvanle|servidle}} con todo {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}} y con todo {{plural_you:su ser|vuestro ser}}».

fr.R: Mais faites bien attention à obéir aux commandements et aux lois que Moïse, le serviteur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, vous a donnés. Aimez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu. vi.L: Chỉ hãy hết sức cẩn thận làm theo điều răn và luật pháp mà Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã truyền cho anh em: yêu kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, đi trong mọi đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, giữ các điều răn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, gắn bó với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và phụng sự {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hết lòng và hết linh hồn."
vi.B: Nhưng hãy hết sức cẩn thận làm theo điều răn và luật pháp mà Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã truyền cho anh em: hãy yêu kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, đi trong mọi đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, giữ các điều răn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, gắn bó với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và hết lòng hết linh hồn phụng sự {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.R: Nhưng hãy hết sức cẩn thận vâng giữ các điều răn và luật lệ mà Môi-se, đầy tớ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã ban cho anh em. Hãy yêu kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em. Hãy sống theo cách {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn anh em sống, và vâng giữ các điều răn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hãy ở gần bên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và hết lòng, hết cả con người mình phụng sự {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."

ko.L: 다만 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 너희에게 명령한 계명과 율법을 매우 조심하여 행하여라. 곧 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 사랑하고, 그분의 모든 길로 걷고, 그분의 계명들을 지키고, 그분께 붙어 있고, 너희 온 마음과 온 목숨을 다하여 그분을 섬기는 것이다."
ko.B: 다만 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 너희에게 명령한 계명과 율법을 아주 조심하여 지켜라. 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 사랑하고, 그분의 모든 길로 걸으며, 그분의 계명을 지키고, 그분께 꼭 붙어 있으며, 마음을 다하고 목숨을 다하여 그분을 섬겨라."
ko.R: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 종 모세가 너희에게 준 계명과 율법을 아주 조심하여 지켜라. 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 사랑하여라. 그분께서 원하시는 대로 살고, 그분의 계명을 지켜라. 그분 곁을 떠나지 말고, 마음과 온몸을 다하여 그분을 섬겨라."

decisions.choice: the law: the whole of Moses' teaching, not only its rules
decisions.reason: The word means instruction or teaching. Joined with "the commandment", it sums up everything Moses taught Israel in the LORD's name (Deuteronomy 1:5; 4:44).

decisions.choice: love, walk, keep, cling, serve: the words of Deuteronomy
decisions.reason: Joshua's charge gathers the language of Moses' sermons (Deuteronomy 10:12; 11:13, 22; 13:5). The warriors leave with the heart of the law ringing in their ears, which makes the alarm over their altar in verses 11-20 all the sharper.

decisions.choice: cling to him: stay loyally joined to the LORD
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a husband joined to his wife (Genesis 2:24) and of Ruth clinging to Naomi (Ruth 1:14). It speaks of a close and loyal bond, not only of obeying rules (Deuteronomy 10:20; 23:8 of Joshua).

decisions.choice: soul: the whole living self
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means life or self, the whole person who breathes and desires. "With all your soul" means with your whole being (Deuteronomy 6:5).

decisions.choice: Live the way he wants you to live; Stay close to him; your whole self
decisions.reason: Readable explains the pictures of walking in his ways and clinging to him, and says "your whole self" for "soul", as it does at Deuteronomy 10:12 and 11:22.

decisions.choice: the deity pronoun setting on "sus caminos" and "a él"; "le sirvan", "sírvanle" with no span
decisions.reason: The deity pronoun setting goes on the Spanish words for God that stand alone; a pronoun joined to the verb ("sírvanle") cannot carry a capital, and the English "serve him" is carried by it, so it has no span, as in the Pentateuch drafts.

decisions.choice: "hết lòng và hết linh hồn" (Literal, Balanced); "hết lòng, hết cả con người mình" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew soul is the whole living self; Readable says so, as the English Readable "your whole self" does.

decisions.choice: "그분" for the LORD in the commands (no deity_pronoun spans)
decisions.reason: Where the English puts "his" and "him" for the LORD under the deity_pronoun setting, Korean says "그분", the respectful pronoun, at every level; the setting has nothing to change in Hangul (13:14). "목숨" carries the Hebrew "soul", the whole living self (meaning decision m4).

decisions.choice: blessed them: asked God's good on them as they parted
decisions.reason: A leader's blessing at a parting or at the end of a great task is a prayer that God will do good to the people (Genesis 47:7; 2 Samuel 6:18; 1 Kings 8:55).

decisions.choice: they went: they set out; the story of the journey resumes in verse 9
decisions.reason: Verses 7-8 step back to add a note on Manasseh and Joshua's parting words; verse 9 then takes up the journey again.

decisions.choice: started for home
decisions.reason: Readable says "home" for "their tents" (see verse 4) and "started" because they reach the Jordan only in verse 10.

records.literal_gloss: And to half [the] tribe of the Manasseh had given Moses in the Bashan, and to its half gave Joshua with their brothers across the Jordan westward. And also when sent them Joshua to their tents, and he blessed them,

en.L: Now to [one] half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given [land] in Bashan, and to its [other] half Joshua had given [land] with their brothers across the Jordan to the west. And also, when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them,

sw.B: Musa alikuwa amewapa nusu moja ya kabila la Manase nchi katika Bashani; nusu nyingine Yoshua alikuwa amewapa nchi upande wa magharibi wa Yordani, kando ya Waisraeli wenzao. Yoshua alipoyaaga makabila ya mashariki yaende nyumbani, aliwabariki
sw.R: Musa alikuwa amewapa nusu moja ya kabila la Manase nchi huko Bashani. Yoshua alikuwa amewapa nusu nyingine ya kabila hilo nchi upande wa magharibi wa Yordani, karibu na makabila mengine. Yoshua alipoyaaga makabila ya mashariki yaende nyumbani, aliwabariki.

es.L: Y a [una] mitad de la tribu de Manasés Moisés [le] había dado [tierra] en Basán, y a su [otra] mitad Josué [le] dio [tierra] con sus hermanos al otro lado del Jordán, al occidente. Y también, cuando Josué los envió a sus tiendas, los bendijo,
es.B: Moisés había dado tierra en Basán a una mitad de la tribu de Manasés; a la otra mitad Josué le había dado tierra al occidente del Jordán, junto a sus compatriotas. Cuando Josué despidió a las tribus del este, los bendijo
es.R: Moisés le había dado tierra en Basán a una mitad de la tribu de Manasés. Josué le había dado tierra a la otra mitad de la tribu, al oeste del Jordán, junto a las demás tribus. Cuando Josué despidió a las tribus del este, los bendijo.

fr.L: Or, à [une] moitié de la tribu de Manassé, Moïse avait donné [des terres] dans le Bashân, et à son [autre] moitié Josué avait donné [des terres] avec leurs frères au-delà du Jourdain, vers l’occident. Et aussi, quand Josué les renvoya à leurs tentes, il les bénit,
fr.B: Moïse avait donné des terres dans le Bashân à l’une des moitiés de la tribu de Manassé ; à l’autre moitié, Josué avait donné des terres à l’ouest du Jourdain, à côté de leurs frères israélites. Quand Josué renvoya chez elles les tribus de l’est, il les bénit
fr.R: Moïse avait donné des terres dans le Bashân à une moitié de la tribu de Manassé. Josué avait donné des terres à l’autre moitié de la tribu, à l’ouest du Jourdain, à côté des autres tribus. Quand Josué a renvoyé chez elles les tribus de l’est, il les a bénies.

vi.L: Cho [một] nửa chi phái Ma-na-se, Môi-se đã ban [đất] ở Ba-san; còn cho nửa [kia] của nó, Giô-suê đã ban [đất] cùng với anh em họ ở bên kia sông Giô-đanh về phía tây. Lại nữa, khi Giô-suê cho họ về trại mình, ông chúc phước cho họ,
vi.B: Môi-se đã ban cho một nửa chi phái Ma-na-se đất ở Ba-san; còn nửa kia thì Giô-suê đã ban đất ở phía tây sông Giô-đanh, bên cạnh các anh em Y-sơ-ra-ên của họ. Khi Giô-suê cho các chi phái phía đông về nhà, ông chúc phước cho họ
vi.R: Môi-se đã ban đất ở Ba-san cho một nửa chi phái Ma-na-se. Giô-suê đã ban đất cho nửa kia của chi phái ấy, ở phía tây sông Giô-đanh, bên cạnh các chi phái khác. Khi Giô-suê cho các chi phái phía đông về nhà, ông chúc phước cho họ.

ko.L: 므낫세 반 지파에게는 모세가 바산에서 [땅을] 주었고, 그 [다른] 반 지파에게는 여호수아가 요단 건너편 서쪽에서 그들의 형제들과 함께 [땅을] 주었다. 그리고 또 여호수아가 그들을 그들의 장막으로 보낼 때에 그들을 축복하고,
ko.B: 모세는 므낫세 지파의 절반에게 바산에서 땅을 주었고, 나머지 절반에게는 여호수아가 요단강 서쪽에서 그들의 형제들 곁에 땅을 주었다. 여호수아는 동쪽 지파들을 집으로 보낼 때 그들을 축복하고
ko.R: 모세는 므낫세 지파의 절반에게 바산에서 땅을 주었다. 여호수아는 므낫세 지파의 나머지 절반에게 요단강 서쪽, 다른 지파들 곁에 땅을 주었다. 여호수아는 동쪽 지파들을 집으로 보낼 때 그들을 축복하였다.

decisions.choice: the two halves of Manasseh: one east of the Jordan, one west
decisions.reason: Manasseh was split: Moses gave the clans of Machir land in Bashan and Gilead east of the river (13:29-31; Numbers 32:39-40), and Joshua gave the rest land west of it, beside Ephraim (17:1-13). The note explains why only half of Manasseh is going home.

decisions.choice: on the other side: the form the margin of the Hebrew text tells readers to read
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text has "from the other side" here; the scribes' marginal note reads "on the other side", the usual phrase, which this translation follows. The place meant is the same either way.

decisions.choice: and also when Joshua sent them away: the narrator returns to the parting of verse 6
decisions.reason: After the note on Manasseh, the narrator goes back to Joshua's farewell to add what he said to the warriors as he blessed them (verse 8). "Them" are all the eastern warriors, Reuben and Gad with the eastern half of Manasseh.

decisions.choice: land; the eastern tribes
decisions.reason: The Hebrew leaves out what was given; Balanced and Readable say "land". They also say "the eastern tribes" for "them", since the last people named are the western half of Manasseh, who are not the ones being sent home.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר בִּנְכָסִ֨ים רַבִּ֜ים שׁ֤וּבוּ אֶל־אָֽהֳלֵיכֶם֙ וּבְמִקְנֶ֣ה רַב־מְאֹ֔ד בְּכֶ֨סֶף וּבְזָהָ֜ב וּבִנְחֹ֧שֶׁת וּבְבַרְזֶ֛ל וּבִשְׂלָמ֖וֹת הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד חִלְק֥וּ שְׁלַל־אֹיְבֵיכֶ֖ם עִם־אֲחֵיכֶֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: and he said to them, saying, With riches great return to your tents, and with livestock much very, with silver and with gold and with bronze and with iron and with garments many very; divide [the] spoil of your enemies with your brothers.

en.L: and said to them, "Return to your tents with great riches, and with very much livestock, with silver and with gold and with bronze and with iron and with very many garments. Divide the spoil of your enemies with your brothers."
en.B: and said to them, "Go back to your homes with great wealth: large herds of livestock, silver, gold, bronze and iron, and a great amount of clothing. Share the plunder taken from your enemies with your relatives at home."
en.R: He said to them, "Go back home. You are taking great wealth with you: many animals, silver, gold, bronze, iron, and lots of clothing. Share what you took from your enemies with your families and the rest of your people back home."

sw.L: na kuwaambia, "Rudini hemani mwenu na mali nyingi, na mifugo mingi sana, na fedha na dhahabu na shaba na chuma na mavazi mengi sana. Gawanyeni nyara za adui zenu pamoja na ndugu zenu."
sw.B: akawaambia, "Rudini nyumbani kwenu na utajiri mwingi: makundi makubwa ya mifugo, fedha, dhahabu, shaba na chuma, na mavazi mengi sana. Gawanyeni nyara mlizowateka adui zenu pamoja na jamaa zenu walio nyumbani."
sw.R: Akawaambia, "Rudini nyumbani. Mnachukua utajiri mwingi pamoja nanyi: wanyama wengi, fedha, dhahabu, shaba, chuma na nguo nyingi. Gawanyeni vitu mlivyowanyang'anya adui zenu pamoja na jamaa zenu na watu wenu wengine walio nyumbani."

es.L: y les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a {{plural_you:sus tiendas|vuestras tiendas}} con grandes riquezas, y con muchísimo ganado, con plata, y con oro, y con bronce, y con hierro, y con muchísima ropa. {{plural_you:Repartan|Repartid}} el botín de {{plural_you:sus enemigos|vuestros enemigos}} con {{plural_you:sus hermanos|vuestros hermanos}}».
es.B: y les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a {{plural_you:sus hogares|vuestros hogares}} con grandes riquezas: muchísimo ganado, plata, oro, bronce y hierro, y gran cantidad de ropa. {{plural_you:Repartan|Repartid}} el botín tomado a {{plural_you:sus enemigos|vuestros enemigos}} con {{plural_you:sus parientes|vuestros parientes}} que se quedaron en casa».
es.R: Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a casa. {{plural_you:Se llevan|Os lleváis}} grandes riquezas: muchos animales, plata, oro, bronce, hierro y mucha ropa. {{plural_you:Compartan|Compartid}} lo que {{plural_you:les quitaron|les quitasteis}} a {{plural_you:sus enemigos|vuestros enemigos}} con {{plural_you:sus familias|vuestras familias}} y con el resto de {{plural_you:su gente|vuestra gente}} allá en casa».

fr.L: et il leur parla, en disant : « Avec de grandes richesses retournez à vos tentes, et avec du bétail en très grand nombre, avec de l’argent, et avec de l’or, et avec du bronze, et avec du fer, et avec des vêtements en très grand nombre ; partagez le butin de vos ennemis avec vos frères. »
fr.B: et leur dit : « Retournez chez vous avec de grandes richesses : de grands troupeaux, de l’argent, de l’or, du bronze et du fer, et une grande quantité de vêtements. Partagez avec vos frères restés chez vous le butin pris à vos ennemis. »
fr.R: Il leur a dit : « Rentrez chez vous. Vous emportez de grandes richesses : beaucoup d’animaux, de l’argent, de l’or, du bronze, du fer et beaucoup de vêtements. Partagez ce que vous avez pris à vos ennemis avec vos familles et le reste de votre peuple, là-bas, chez vous. »

vi.L: và nói với họ: "Hãy trở về trại mình với nhiều của cải, với rất nhiều súc vật, với bạc, vàng, đồng, sắt, và rất nhiều quần áo. Hãy chia chiến lợi phẩm lấy từ kẻ thù với anh em mình."
vi.B: và nói với họ: "Hãy trở về nhà với nhiều của cải: đàn súc vật đông đúc, bạc, vàng, đồng, sắt, và rất nhiều quần áo. Hãy chia chiến lợi phẩm lấy từ kẻ thù cho bà con ở nhà."
vi.R: Ông nói với họ: "Hãy trở về nhà. Anh em đem theo nhiều của cải: nhiều súc vật, bạc, vàng, đồng, sắt, và rất nhiều quần áo. Hãy chia những gì anh em đã lấy từ kẻ thù cho gia đình và những người khác trong chi phái mình ở nhà."

ko.L: 그들에게 말했다. "많은 재물과 아주 많은 가축과 은과 금과 놋과 쇠와 아주 많은 옷을 가지고 너희 장막으로 돌아가거라. 너희 원수들에게서 빼앗은 것을 너희 형제들과 나누어라."
ko.B: 그들에게 말했다. "많은 재물, 곧 많은 가축 떼와 은과 금과 놋과 쇠와 아주 많은 옷을 가지고 너희 집으로 돌아가거라. 원수들에게서 빼앗은 것을 고향에 있는 친척들과 나누어라."
ko.R: 여호수아가 그들에게 말했다. "집으로 돌아가거라. 너희는 많은 재물을 가지고 간다. 많은 짐승과 은과 금과 놋과 쇠와 아주 많은 옷이다. 원수들에게서 빼앗은 것을 고향에 있는 너희 가족과 백성과 함께 나누어라."

decisions.choice: with great riches: placed first for weight
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts "with great riches" before the verb "return", stressing the wealth they take home. The warriors who left their families to fight come back rich (compare 8:2, 27; 11:14).

decisions.choice: divide the spoil with your brothers: share it with those of their own tribes who stayed east
decisions.reason: Only the fighting men crossed; the families and many others stayed in Gilead (1:14; Numbers 32:26-27). The rule that those at home share the spoil with the warriors goes back to Numbers 31:27 and is kept by David (1 Samuel 30:24-25). "Your brothers" here are their own kin east of the river.

decisions.choice: your relatives at home (Balanced); your families and the rest of your people back home (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make plain that the "brothers" are the people of their own tribes waiting at home, not the western tribes (see m2).

source.text: וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ וַיֵּלְכ֡וּ בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵ֨ן וּבְנֵי־גָ֜ד וַחֲצִ֣י׀שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֗ה מֵאֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִשִּׁלֹ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־כְּנָ֑עַן לָלֶ֜כֶת אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֗ד אֶל־אֶ֤רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נֹֽאחֲזוּ־בָ֔הּ עַל־פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And returned and went [the] sons of Reuben and [the] sons of Gad and half [the] tribe of the Manasseh from with [the] sons of Israel from Shiloh which [is] in [the] land of Canaan, to go to [the] land of the Gilead, to [the] land of their possession which they had taken possession in it at [the] mouth of Yahweh by [the] hand of Moses.

en.L: So the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned and went away from the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel at Shiloh, which [is] in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they had taken possession of at the command of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} by the hand of Moses.
en.B: So the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh turned back and parted from the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} at Shiloh, in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead. That was their own land, which had become theirs at the command of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} given through Moses.
en.R: So the tribes of Reuben and Gad and half of the tribe of Manasseh left the other {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} at Shiloh, in Canaan. They headed home to the land of Gilead. It was their own land. They had received it because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded it through Moses.

sw.L: Basi wana wa Reubeni na wana wa Gadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase wakarudi, wakaondoka kutoka kwa wana wa Israeli huko Shilo, ulio katika nchi ya Kanaani, kwenda nchi ya Gileadi, nchi ya milki yao, waliyoimiliki kwa agizo la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa mkono wa Musa.
sw.B: Basi Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase walirudi, wakaachana na Waisraeli huko Shilo, katika nchi ya Kanaani, ili waende nchi ya Gileadi. Hiyo ilikuwa nchi yao wenyewe, iliyokuwa yao kwa agizo la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lililotolewa kupitia Musa.
sw.R: Basi makabila ya Reubeni na Gadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase waliwaacha Waisraeli wengine huko Shilo, katika Kanaani. Wakaelekea nyumbani katika nchi ya Gileadi. Ilikuwa nchi yao wenyewe. Walikuwa wameipokea kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliamuru hivyo kupitia Musa.

es.L: Y volvieron y se fueron los hijos de Rubén y los hijos de Gad y la media tribu de Manasés, de con los hijos de Israel, de Silo, que [está] en la tierra de Canaán, para ir a la tierra de Galaad, a la tierra de su posesión, de la cual habían tomado posesión conforme a la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} por mano de Moisés.
es.B: Así los rubenitas, los gaditas y la media tribu de Manasés se volvieron y se separaron de los israelitas en Silo, en la tierra de Canaán, para ir a la tierra de Galaad. Esa era su propia tierra, que había llegado a ser suya por orden {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} dada por medio de Moisés.
es.R: Así que las tribus de Rubén y Gad y la mitad de la tribu de Manasés se separaron de los demás israelitas en Silo, en Canaán. Se fueron a casa, a la tierra de Galaad. Era su propia tierra. La habían recibido porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo había mandado por medio de Moisés.

fr.L: Et les fils de Ruben, et les fils de Gad, et la demi-tribu de Manassé s’en retournèrent et s’en allèrent d’auprès des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, de Silo, qui [est] dans le pays de Canaan, pour aller au pays de Galaad, au pays de leur possession, dont ils avaient pris possession selon la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} par la main de Moïse.
fr.B: Les Rubénites, les Gadites et la demi-tribu de Manassé s’en retournèrent donc et quittèrent les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} à Silo, au pays de Canaan, pour aller au pays de Galaad. C’était leur pays à eux, qui leur était revenu sur l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} donné par l’intermédiaire de Moïse.
fr.R: Les tribus de Ruben et de Gad et la moitié de la tribu de Manassé ont donc quitté les autres {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} à Silo, dans le pays de Canaan. Ils sont rentrés au pays de Galaad. C’était leur pays à eux. Ils l’avaient reçu parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné par l’intermédiaire de Moïse.

vi.L: Vậy con cháu Ru-bên, con cháu Gát và nửa chi phái Ma-na-se trở về, rời khỏi con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Si-lô, trong xứ Ca-na-an, để đi đến đất Ga-la-át, đất sở hữu của họ, mà họ đã chiếm hữu theo lệnh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} qua tay Môi-se.
vi.B: Vậy người Ru-bên, người Gát và nửa chi phái Ma-na-se quay về, chia tay dân Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Si-lô, trong xứ Ca-na-an, để đi đến đất Ga-la-át. Đó là đất của riêng họ, đã thuộc về họ theo lệnh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} truyền qua Môi-se.
vi.R: Vậy các chi phái Ru-bên và Gát và nửa chi phái Ma-na-se rời các chi phái Y-sơ-ra-ên khác tại Si-lô, trong xứ Ca-na-an. Họ lên đường về đất Ga-la-át. Đó là đất của riêng họ. Họ đã nhận đất ấy vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền như vậy qua Môi-se.

ko.L: 그래서 르우벤 자손과 갓 자손과 므낫세 반 지파가 가나안 땅에 있는 실로에서 이스라엘 자손을 떠나 돌아가서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령대로 모세를 통하여 그들이 차지한 그들의 소유의 땅, 길르앗 땅으로 갔다.
ko.B: 그래서 르우벤 사람과 갓 사람과 므낫세 반 지파는 가나안 땅 실로에서 이스라엘 자손과 헤어져, 길르앗 땅으로 돌아갔다. 그 땅은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세를 통하여 명령하신 대로 그들의 소유가 된 땅이었다.
ko.R: 그래서 르우벤 지파와 갓 지파와 므낫세 지파의 절반은 가나안 땅 실로에서 다른 이스라엘 백성과 헤어졌다. 그들은 길르앗 땅으로 돌아갔다. 그곳은 그들의 땅이었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세를 통하여 명령하셨기 때문에 그들이 그 땅을 받았다.

decisions.choice: Shiloh: where the tent of meeting stood
decisions.reason: Israel had set up the tent of meeting at Shiloh, and the last lots for the land were cast there (18:1, 8-10; 19:51). The altar story turns on this: Shiloh is the place of the LORD's sanctuary (verses 19, 29).

decisions.choice: the land of Gilead: here the whole land of the eastern tribes
decisions.reason: Gilead is properly the hill country east of the Jordan between the Yarmuk and the Arnon valleys, but it can stand for all the land the two and a half tribes held there (Numbers 32:1, 29; Judges 20:1).

decisions.choice: at the mouth of the LORD by the hand of Moses: by the LORD's command, given through Moses
decisions.reason: "Mouth" stands for what someone says and "hand" for the person through whom something is done. The eastern land was theirs by God's own word through Moses (Numbers 32:28-33).

decisions.choice: the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "sons of". These are the tribes' warriors going home, so no gender setting is used. Balanced and Readable use the fixed names given at verse 1.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ אֶל־גְּלִיל֣וֹת הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיִּבְנ֣וּ בְנֵי־רְאוּבֵ֣ן וּבְנֵי־גָ֡ד וַחֲצִ֣י שֵׁבֶט֩ הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֨ה שָׁ֤ם מִזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ עַל־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן מִזְבֵּ֥חַ גָּד֖וֹל לְמַרְאֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they came to [the] districts of the Jordan which [is] in [the] land of Canaan, and built [the] sons of Reuben and [the] sons of Gad and half [the] tribe of the Manasseh there an altar by the Jordan, an altar great in appearance.

en.L: And they came to the districts of the Jordan that [are] in the land of Canaan, and the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, an altar great to look at.
en.B: When they reached the region along the Jordan that lies in the land of Canaan, the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, an altar of imposing size.
en.R: When they came to the area by the Jordan River, on the Canaan side, the tribes of Reuben and Gad and half of the tribe of Manasseh built an altar there beside the river. It was very big and easy to see.

sw.L: Nao wakafika katika maeneo ya Yordani yaliyo katika nchi ya Kanaani, na wana wa Reubeni na wana wa Gadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase wakajenga madhabahu huko kando ya Yordani, madhabahu kubwa kwa kutazama.
sw.B: Walipofika katika eneo lililo kando ya Yordani, katika nchi ya Kanaani, Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase walijenga madhabahu huko kando ya Yordani, madhabahu kubwa ya kuvutia macho.
sw.R: Walipofika katika eneo lililo kando ya Mto Yordani, upande wa Kanaani, makabila ya Reubeni na Gadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase walijenga madhabahu huko kando ya mto. Ilikuwa kubwa sana na rahisi kuonekana.

es.L: Y llegaron a las regiones del Jordán que [están] en la tierra de Canaán, y los hijos de Rubén y los hijos de Gad y la media tribu de Manasés edificaron allí un altar junto al Jordán, un altar grande a la vista.
es.B: Cuando llegaron a la región junto al Jordán que está en la tierra de Canaán, los rubenitas, los gaditas y la media tribu de Manasés construyeron allí un altar junto al Jordán, un altar de tamaño imponente.
es.R: Cuando llegaron a la zona del río Jordán, del lado de Canaán, las tribus de Rubén y Gad y la mitad de la tribu de Manasés construyeron allí un altar junto al río. Era muy grande y se veía desde lejos.

fr.L: Et ils arrivèrent aux districts du Jourdain qui [sont] dans le pays de Canaan, et les fils de Ruben, et les fils de Gad, et la demi-tribu de Manassé bâtirent là un autel près du Jourdain, un autel grand à voir.
fr.B: Quand ils arrivèrent à la région qui borde le Jourdain, dans le pays de Canaan, les Rubénites, les Gadites et la demi-tribu de Manassé bâtirent là un autel près du Jourdain, un autel de taille imposante.
fr.R: Quand ils sont arrivés dans la région du Jourdain, du côté de Canaan, les tribus de Ruben et de Gad et la moitié de la tribu de Manassé ont bâti un autel au bord du fleuve. Il était très grand, et on le voyait de loin.

vi.L: Họ đến các miền dọc sông Giô-đanh [ở] trong xứ Ca-na-an, và con cháu Ru-bên, con cháu Gát và nửa chi phái Ma-na-se xây một bàn thờ tại đó bên sông Giô-đanh, một bàn thờ trông rất lớn.
vi.B: Khi đến miền dọc sông Giô-đanh thuộc xứ Ca-na-an, người Ru-bên, người Gát và nửa chi phái Ma-na-se xây một bàn thờ tại đó bên sông Giô-đanh, một bàn thờ to lớn đồ sộ.
vi.R: Khi đến vùng bên sông Giô-đanh, ở phía xứ Ca-na-an, các chi phái Ru-bên và Gát và nửa chi phái Ma-na-se xây một bàn thờ tại đó bên bờ sông. Bàn thờ ấy rất lớn, ai cũng thấy rõ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 가나안 땅에 있는 요단 지역에 이르렀을 때, 르우벤 자손과 갓 자손과 므낫세 반 지파가 거기 요단 곁에 제단을 쌓았으니, 보기에 큰 제단이었다.
ko.B: 르우벤 사람과 갓 사람과 므낫세 반 지파는 가나안 땅에 있는 요단강 지역에 이르렀을 때, 거기 요단강 가에 제단을 쌓았다. 그것은 눈에 띄게 큰 제단이었다.
ko.R: 르우벤 지파와 갓 지파와 므낫세 지파의 절반은 요단강 가, 가나안 쪽 지역에 이르렀을 때, 그 강 가에 제단을 쌓았다. 그 제단은 아주 커서 멀리서도 잘 보였다.

decisions.choice: the districts of the Jordan: the land along the river, perhaps a place called Geliloth
decisions.reason: The word means circles or districts. It may describe the land along the river here, or name a place, Geliloth, which 18:17 places near the border of Benjamin. The site of the altar cannot be fixed.

decisions.choice: in the land of Canaan: the altar stood west of the river
decisions.reason: "Canaan" here is the land west of the Jordan (verses 9, 32). So the tribes built the altar before they crossed back to their own land, on the side where the other tribes lived (see verse 11).

decisions.choice: great in appearance: large and meant to be seen
decisions.reason: The altar was built to be noticed. The builders explain why in verses 26-28: it was a copy of the LORD's altar, set up as a lasting witness, not for sacrifice.

decisions.choice: on the Canaan side
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly which bank of the river is meant, since "in the land of Canaan" means the west side here (m2).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁמְע֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֣ה בָנ֣וּ בְנֵֽי־רְאוּבֵ֣ן וּבְנֵי־גָ֡ד וַחֲצִי֩ שֵׁ֨בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֜ה אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ אֶל־מוּל֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֶל־גְּלִילוֹת֙ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֶל־עֵ֖בֶר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And heard [the] sons of Israel, saying, Look, have built [the] sons of Reuben and [the] sons of Gad and half [the] tribe of the Manasseh the altar at [the] front of [the] land of Canaan, in [the] districts of the Jordan, on [the] side of [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel heard [it] said, "Look, the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built the altar at the frontier of the land of Canaan, in the districts of the Jordan, on the side belonging to the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel."
en.B: Then the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} heard the report: "The Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar at the edge of the land of Canaan, in the region along the Jordan, on the Israelite side."
en.R: Then the other {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} heard what had happened. People said, "The tribes of Reuben and Gad and half of the tribe of Manasseh have built an altar at the edge of Canaan. It is by the Jordan River, on our side of the river."

sw.L: Na wana wa Israeli wakasikia [ikisemwa], "Tazama, wana wa Reubeni na wana wa Gadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase wamejenga madhabahu kwenye mpaka wa nchi ya Kanaani, katika maeneo ya Yordani, upande ulio wa wana wa Israeli."
sw.B: Ndipo Waisraeli wakasikia habari: "Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase wamejenga madhabahu kwenye ukingo wa nchi ya Kanaani, katika eneo lililo kando ya Yordani, upande wa Waisraeli."
sw.R: Kisha Waisraeli wengine wakasikia yaliyotokea. Watu walisema, "Makabila ya Reubeni na Gadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase wamejenga madhabahu kwenye ukingo wa Kanaani. Iko kando ya Mto Yordani, upande wetu wa mto."

es.L: Y los hijos de Israel oyeron decir: «He aquí, los hijos de Rubén y los hijos de Gad y la media tribu de Manasés han edificado el altar frente a la tierra de Canaán, en las regiones del Jordán, del lado de los hijos de Israel».
es.B: Entonces los israelitas oyeron la noticia: «Los rubenitas, los gaditas y la media tribu de Manasés han construido un altar en el borde de la tierra de Canaán, en la región junto al Jordán, del lado israelita».
es.R: Entonces los demás israelitas oyeron lo que había pasado. La gente decía: «Las tribus de Rubén y Gad y la mitad de la tribu de Manasés han construido un altar en el borde de Canaán. Está junto al río Jordán, de nuestro lado del río».

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël entendirent dire : « Voici, les fils de Ruben, et les fils de Gad, et la demi-tribu de Manassé ont bâti l’autel en face du pays de Canaan, dans les districts du Jourdain, du côté des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël. »
fr.B: Alors les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} apprirent la nouvelle : « Les Rubénites, les Gadites et la demi-tribu de Manassé ont bâti un autel à la limite du pays de Canaan, dans la région qui borde le Jourdain, du côté israélite. »
fr.R: Alors les autres {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont appris ce qui s’était passé. On disait : « Les tribus de Ruben et de Gad et la moitié de la tribu de Manassé ont bâti un autel à la limite du pays de Canaan. Il est au bord du Jourdain, de notre côté du fleuve. »

vi.L: Con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên nghe người ta nói: "Kìa, con cháu Ru-bên, con cháu Gát và nửa chi phái Ma-na-se đã xây bàn thờ ở biên giới xứ Ca-na-an, trong các miền dọc sông Giô-đanh, bên phía thuộc về con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên."
vi.B: Bấy giờ dân Y-sơ-ra-ên nghe tin: "Người Ru-bên, người Gát và nửa chi phái Ma-na-se đã xây một bàn thờ ở biên giới xứ Ca-na-an, trong miền dọc sông Giô-đanh, bên phía Y-sơ-ra-ên."
vi.R: Bấy giờ các chi phái Y-sơ-ra-ên khác nghe biết việc đã xảy ra. Người ta nói: "Các chi phái Ru-bên và Gát và nửa chi phái Ma-na-se đã xây một bàn thờ ở biên giới xứ Ca-na-an. Bàn thờ ấy ở bên sông Giô-đanh, phía bên này sông của chúng ta."

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 [이런 말을] 들었다. "보라, 르우벤 자손과 갓 자손과 므낫세 반 지파가 가나안 땅의 경계, 요단 지역, 이스라엘 자손에게 속한 쪽에 그 제단을 쌓았다."
ko.B: 그때 이스라엘 자손에게 이런 소식이 들려왔다. "르우벤 사람과 갓 사람과 므낫세 반 지파가 가나안 땅 끝, 요단강 지역, 이스라엘 자손 쪽에 제단을 쌓았다."
ko.R: 그때 다른 이스라엘 백성은 무슨 일이 일어났는지 들었다. 사람들이 말했다. "르우벤 지파와 갓 지파와 므낫세 지파의 절반이 가나안 땅 끝에 제단을 쌓았다. 그 제단은 요단강 가, 우리 쪽에 있다."

decisions.choice: at the frontier of Canaan, on the Israelites' side: on the west bank, at the edge of the land
alternatives: facing the land of Canaan, on the east bank
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean "facing the land of Canaan", which some take to put the altar on the east bank, looking across. But verse 10 says the altar was "in the land of Canaan", and "on the side of the sons of Israel" most naturally means the side where the other tribes lived. Read together, the report places it on the west bank at the border, where all Israel could see it.

decisions.choice: the altar: the one just described
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the altar", pointing back to the great altar of verse 10.

decisions.choice: People said; on our side of the river
decisions.reason: Readable turns "heard, saying" into a report people passed on, and puts "the side of the sons of Israel" in the words of the Israelites who are speaking.

source.text: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּקָּ֨הֲל֜וּ כָּל־עֲדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שִׁלֹ֔ה לַעֲל֥וֹת עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לַצָּבָֽא׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And heard [the] sons of Israel, and assembled all [the] congregation of [the] sons of Israel [at] Shiloh to go up against them for war.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel heard [it], and the whole congregation of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel gathered at Shiloh to go up against them to war.
en.B: When the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} heard this, the whole congregation of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} assembled at Shiloh to march out and fight against them.
en.R: When the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} heard about it, the whole community gathered at Shiloh. They were ready to go to war against the eastern tribes.

sw.L: Na wana wa Israeli wakasikia, na jumuiya yote ya wana wa Israeli wakakusanyika Shilo ili kupanda kupigana nao vita.
sw.B: Waisraeli waliposikia hayo, jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli ilikusanyika huko Shilo ili kwenda kupigana nao.
sw.R: Waisraeli waliposikia habari hiyo, jumuiya yote ilikusanyika huko Shilo. Walikuwa tayari kwenda vitani dhidi ya makabila ya mashariki.

es.L: Y lo oyeron los hijos de Israel, y se reunió toda la comunidad de los hijos de Israel en Silo para subir contra ellos a la guerra.
es.B: Cuando los israelitas lo oyeron, toda la comunidad de los israelitas se reunió en Silo para salir a pelear contra ellos.
es.R: Cuando los israelitas se enteraron, toda la comunidad se reunió en Silo. Estaban listos para ir a la guerra contra las tribus del este.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël [l’]entendirent, et toute la communauté des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël s’assembla à Silo pour monter contre eux en guerre.
fr.B: Quand les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} apprirent cela, toute la communauté des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} se rassembla à Silo pour partir combattre contre eux.
fr.R: Quand les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} l’ont appris, toute la communauté s’est rassemblée à Silo. Ils étaient prêts à partir en guerre contre les tribus de l’est.

vi.L: Con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên nghe [điều đó], và toàn thể hội chúng con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên nhóm lại tại Si-lô để đi lên đánh họ.
vi.B: Khi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên nghe điều ấy, toàn thể hội chúng Y-sơ-ra-ên nhóm lại tại Si-lô để kéo quân đi đánh họ.
vi.R: Khi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên nghe việc ấy, cả cộng đồng nhóm lại tại Si-lô. Họ sẵn sàng đi đánh các chi phái phía đông.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 [그것을] 들었다. 그리고 이스라엘 자손의 온 회중이 그들에게 싸우러 올라가려고 실로에 모였다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 자손은 그 소식을 듣고, 온 회중이 그들과 싸우러 올라가려고 실로에 모였다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성은 그 소식을 듣고 모두 실로에 모였다. 그들은 동쪽 지파들과 전쟁을 하러 갈 준비를 하였다.

decisions.choice: to go up against them to war: the law's response to a rival altar
decisions.reason: The law allowed sacrifice only at the one place the LORD would choose (Deuteronomy 12:5-14; Leviticus 17:8-9), and it ordered war on any town in Israel that turned to other worship (Deuteronomy 13:13-19). The other tribes read the altar as that kind of rebellion (verses 16-19).

decisions.choice: at Shiloh: at the sanctuary
decisions.reason: They gather where the tent of meeting stands (18:1), the place that the new altar seemed to challenge.

decisions.choice: the eastern tribes
decisions.reason: Readable names the tribes meant by "them", since a new sentence begins.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלְח֨וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל־בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵ֧ן וְאֶל־בְּנֵי־גָ֛ד וְאֶל־חֲצִ֥י שֵֽׁבֶט־מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֑ד אֶת־פִּינְחָ֖ס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָ֥ר הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent [the] sons of Israel to [the] sons of Reuben and to [the] sons of Gad and to half [the] tribe of Manasseh, to [the] land of the Gilead, Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel sent to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest.
en.B: So the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} sent Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh in the land of Gilead.
en.R: So the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} sent Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest to the tribes of Reuben and Gad and half of the tribe of Manasseh in the land of Gilead.

sw.L: Na wana wa Israeli wakatuma kwa wana wa Reubeni na wana wa Gadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase, katika nchi ya Gileadi, Finehasi mwana wa Eleazari kuhani.
sw.B: Basi Waisraeli walimtuma Finehasi mwana wa Eleazari kuhani kwa Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase katika nchi ya Gileadi.
sw.R: Basi Waisraeli walimtuma Finehasi mwana wa Eleazari kuhani kwa makabila ya Reubeni na Gadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase katika nchi ya Gileadi.

es.L: Y enviaron los hijos de Israel a los hijos de Rubén, y a los hijos de Gad, y a la media tribu de Manasés, a la tierra de Galaad, a Finés hijo del sacerdote Eleazar,
es.B: Así que los israelitas enviaron a Finés hijo del sacerdote Eleazar a los rubenitas, a los gaditas y a la media tribu de Manasés, en la tierra de Galaad.
es.R: Así que los israelitas enviaron a Finés hijo del sacerdote Eleazar a las tribus de Rubén y Gad y a la mitad de la tribu de Manasés, en la tierra de Galaad.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël envoyèrent vers les fils de Ruben, et vers les fils de Gad, et vers la demi-tribu de Manassé, au pays de Galaad, Phinéas, fils d’Éléazar le prêtre,
fr.B: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} envoyèrent donc Phinéas, fils d’Éléazar le prêtre, auprès des Rubénites, des Gadites et de la demi-tribu de Manassé, au pays de Galaad.
fr.R: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont donc envoyé Phinéas, fils d’Éléazar le prêtre, auprès des tribus de Ruben et de Gad et de la moitié de la tribu de Manassé, au pays de Galaad.

vi.L: Con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên sai đến con cháu Ru-bên, con cháu Gát và nửa chi phái Ma-na-se, đến đất Ga-la-át, Phi-nê-a con trai thầy tế lễ Ê-lê-a-sa.
vi.B: Vậy dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sai Phi-nê-a con trai thầy tế lễ Ê-lê-a-sa đến với người Ru-bên, người Gát và nửa chi phái Ma-na-se trong đất Ga-la-át.
vi.R: Vậy dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sai Phi-nê-a con trai thầy tế lễ Ê-lê-a-sa đến với các chi phái Ru-bên và Gát và nửa chi phái Ma-na-se trong đất Ga-la-át.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 르우벤 자손과 갓 자손과 므낫세 반 지파에게, 길르앗 땅으로, 제사장 엘르아살의 아들 비느하스를 보냈다.
ko.B: 그래서 이스라엘 자손은 제사장 엘르아살의 아들 비느하스를 길르앗 땅에 있는 르우벤 사람과 갓 사람과 므낫세 반 지파에게 보냈다.
ko.R: 그래서 이스라엘 백성은 제사장 엘르아살의 아들 비느하스를 길르앗 땅에 있는 르우벤 지파와 갓 지파와 므낫세 지파의 절반에게 보냈다.

decisions.choice: Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest: the priest known for his zeal at Peor
decisions.reason: Phinehas had acted against the sin at Peor and was given a covenant of lasting priesthood (Numbers 25:7-13); he also went with the army against Midian (Numbers 31:6). His father Eleazar was the chief priest (14:1; 21:1). Sending him shows how seriously the matter was taken, and Peor is the first thing the delegation mentions (verse 17).

decisions.choice: they sent: they ask before they fight
decisions.reason: Before striking, Israel sends to find out the truth, as the law required when a town was accused of turning away (Deuteronomy 13:15).

decisions.choice: sent Phinehas ... to
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the people sent to before the man who was sent. Balanced and Readable put Phinehas first, the usual English order.

decisions.choice: "Finés"
decisions.reason: Phinehas in the form the Spanish of Numbers 25 and the Pentateuch terms list use.

decisions.choice: a leader one, a leader one: one leader each
decisions.reason: Saying a phrase twice gives it a sense of "each" or "every": one leader for each ancestral house.

decisions.choice: ten leaders: one for each tribe west of the Jordan
decisions.reason: With Levi holding no tribal land and the two and a half eastern tribes on the other side, ten tribes remain west of the river (counting the western half of Manasseh). Here the "house of a father" seems to stand for a whole tribe, so the ten leaders speak for all of western Israel.

decisions.choice: the thousands of Israel: the large family groups, the clans
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 1:16, "thousands" names the clans into which the tribes were divided, not a count of a thousand people.

decisions.choice: one from each of the tribes on the west side of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Readable says which tribes the ten came from, using the count explained in m2.

decisions.choice: "les milliers d'Israël" (L), "les clans d'Israël" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word for "thousand" also names a clan, a large unit of the tribe. Literal keeps the word; Balanced and Readable say "clans", as the English does. The same holds in verses 21 and 30.

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 천천" (L); "이스라엘 종족들" (B, R) for "the thousands of Israel"
decisions.reason: The "thousands" are the large family groups, the clans (meaning decision m3), not army units; "천부장" would make the men officers. Literal keeps the Hebrew word "천천" (thousands); Balanced and Readable say "종족". The same holds in verses 21 and 30.

en.B: "The whole congregation of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: 'How could you commit such a breach of faith against the God of Israel? fr.R: « Voici ce que dit toute la communauté du peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} : “Comment avez-vous pu être aussi infidèles au Dieu d’Israël ? Aujourd’hui, vous vous êtes détournés {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Vous vous êtes bâti un autel, et c’est une révolte contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

Hôm nay anh em đã quay lưng không theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nữa khi xây cho mình một bàn thờ, nổi loạn chống lại {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngay trong ngày nay.

ko.L: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 온 회중이 이렇게 말합니다. '너희가 이스라엘의 하나님께 저지른 이 배신이 무엇입니까? 오늘 너희를 위하여 제단을 쌓아 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 따르던 데서 돌아서고, 오늘 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 반역하다니요?
